$comment: Which OpenArchiver versions the Integration matrix tests against. The snapshot is one commit-SHA tag from Docker Hub, an early warning for upstream breaking changes; the releases are OSS semver tags and stay blocking -- keep them to the current release and the one before it. This lives outside .github/workflows/ on purpose: GitHub refuses any GITHUB_TOKEN push that touches a workflow file, so the Snapshot check workflow could not open its re-pin PR if the value sat in integration.yml.
label: fix(ingestion): stop concurrent writers overwriting each other's archived file (ee commit 5cf84fff4ef1a3260fb99736dc2b09a0d5146777)
